beats.text: Recurrent neural networks forced words into a sequential bottleneck, choking translation quality on every single long sentence.
beats.visual_focus: A linear chain of recurrent nodes snapping under pressure.

visual_blueprint.title: RECURRENT BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Serialized dependency chain creates latency death spiral

motif_params.title: RECURRENT BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Serialized dependency chain creates latency death spiral

beats.text: Like a slow-motion conveyor belt, standard architectures processed tokens one by one, waiting an eternity for the previous hidden state.
beats.visual_focus: A conveyor belt stalled while the previous unit finishes compute.

visual_blueprint.title: SEQUENTIAL STALL
visual_blueprint.sub: Dependency blockage in RNN/LSTM memory pipelines

motif_params.title: SEQUENTIAL STALL
motif_params.sub: Dependency blockage in RNN/LSTM memory pipelines

beats.text: The Transformer shattered this linearity by abandoning recurrence entirely, relying on a global attention mechanism to view all words simultaneously.
beats.visual_focus: A dense mesh of lines connecting every word to every other word.

visual_blueprint.title: THE 28.4 BLEU SHOC ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: A dense mesh of lines connecting every word to every other word.

beats.text: By projecting tokens into Query, Key, and Value spaces, the model computes relevance scores in parallel, ditching the slow recurrent loop.
